derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of G43 (ἀγκάλη);
def: to take in one's arms, i.e. embrace

occurrences.text: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
